decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The Sales Centre shall be erected for a temporary period only, with it to be entirely removed on occupation of 80% of the private residential units on the site (as approved under planning permission 00657/P/P13) or before four years from the date of this permission, whichever is the sooner. Following removal of the Sales Centre the land shall be landscaped in accordance with the approved landscape details for the site.

Condition : 3 - Four carparking spaces shall be allocated at all times on the site for the exclusive use by the Sales Centre visitors. Two spaces shall be allocated on the public square for disabled carparking spaces for the Sales Centre.

Condition : 4 - The occupation of the Sales Centre shall not start until: (i) A section 278 agreement has been reached with Transport for London and a schedule of works to remove the traffic island within the slip road has been approved; and (ii) The approved works have been completed in accordance with the Highway Authority, and have been certified in writing as complete on behalf of the Highway Authority; unless alternative arrangements to secure the specified works have been approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - During construction and servicing of the Sales Centre, no vehicles shall park/load/unload/wait/pick up/ drop off on the TLRN public highway of A205 at any time. No skip/construction materials shall be kept on the carriageway or footway of the A205 at any time.
Condition : 6 - No construction/servicing vehicles shall enter/exit the site/access road by reversing to/from the main carriageway of the A205.

Condition : 7 - The Sales Centre hereby permitted shall not occupied or opened until a scheme to: (i) Ensure the grill used to fence the void under the building is of appropriate dimensions; and (ii) Ensure finished floor levels are set no lower than 6.25m above Ordance Datum (AOD). The scheme shall be submitted to, and approved in writing, by the local planning authority, prior to the commencement of works associated with the Sales Centre. The scheme shall be fully implemented and subsequently maintained thereafter whilst the Sales Centre is open.
Condition : 8 - The Sales Centre hereby permitted shall not be occupied as a dwelling.
description: Erection of a temporary two-storey sales and information centre with associated car parking
